title: Inventory Value for an earlier date still counts a part untracked today
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVPAST-01) at {Location-A} was active and tracked with 4 in {Bin-A} at a cost of $10.00 at the end of day {Date-A} (for example 13 October 2026), and is still tracked when the steps start on a later day.
  • The Inventory Value report saved the figures for {Date-A} overnight, so a report for {Date-A} lists {Part-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Parts → Inventory and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open Reports → Inventory Value.
  5. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  6. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  7. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the report's Search box.
  8. Read the {Part-A} row and the Totals row.
  9. Change the as-of date to today.
  10. Read the rows and the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: {Part-A} is still listed for {Date-A} with Qty 4.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (4 × $10.00); Totals Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00. Turning tracking off today did not change {Date-A}'s figures.
  • Step 10: For today {Part-A} is not listed; Totals reads Qty 0.00 and Total Cost $0.00, or the report shows its empty state.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Feature Overview, Accounting, and S4-R9, read 13 Oct 2026. Story SV-10818 acceptance criterion on the Inventory Value report for a date before tracking was turned off agrees. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §2 Accounting: “The Inventory Value report run for a past date shows each part as it was on that date. Turning tracking off today does not change an earlier date's figures.”
  • PRD §2 Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values.”
  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
  • SV-10818 acceptance criteria: “Given the Inventory Value report for a date before tracking was turned off, when it runs, then the part is included as it was that day.”
